<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has responded with available slots for all four partners and has asked me to book the earliest one.

The earliest slot is Tuesday, November 17 at 1:30 PM. I will now create this booking.

1:30 PM is 13:30 in 24-hour format.
The day is Tuesday, so `Tue`.

So I will call `create_booking` with `day='Tue'` and `start='13:30'`.

After creating the booking, I need to inform Brad that it's done so he can send the confirmation email. I'll add another entry to the workspace.Brad has identified the common availability and requested I book the earliest slot. I will now book the meeting for Tuesday at 1:30 PM and then notify Brad that the booking is complete so he can send the confirmation email.

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, I've booked the meeting for Tuesday, November 17 at 1:30 PM as you requested. It's all set for you to send the confirmation email. Thanks, Alison."}
